missions.objective: Identify the largest measured funnel bottleneck and recommend the next measurement or intervention without inventing causality.
missions.context: An ad campaign produced 1,400 ad clicks, 1,200 landing-page visits, 120 playground sessions, and 0 account signups.
successCriteria: Correctly identify playground-to-signup as the largest measured loss.
Distinguish the measured bottleneck from its still-unknown root cause.
Recommend an actionable next measurement or intervention.

missions.objective: State the controlling Project Heron churn target and explain the conflicting evidence concisely.
missions.context: Board draft dated 2026-05-10: proposed 12% annual churn target. CFO operating memo approved 2026-07-26: current annual churn target is 18% and supersedes the May board draft.
successCriteria: Identify the approved CFO memo as controlling.
Explain that 12% came from the superseded draft.

missions.objective: Design a creative but executable partner-led growth plan for AMOS that prioritizes VARs, MSPs, and affiliates while keeping the operating team small.
missions.context: Current MRR is $7,100. A $5,000 MRR deal has been signed but should not be counted until it appears in Stripe. Growth should primarily be partner-led. Marketing, influencer, and ad spend may scale with revenue. AMOS can use governed autonomous goals, loops, connected finance data, and human approvals for consequential actions.
successCriteria: Separate verified current revenue from signed but not yet collected revenue.
Provide a staged partner acquisition and activation system.
Identify bounded autonomous loops and their approval boundaries.
Define leading indicators, stopping rules, and a first 30-day execution sequence.
